set_aside.subject: relinking customer references after a repeated import
set_aside.text: A repeated import mints new `customer_ref`s for the Customers it makes; a consumer that kept one the lost import minted relinks it in its own service, as R0-79 says for ids production does not hold.
set_aside.question: Who initiates this relink, how is each lost `customer_ref` deterministically matched to the replacement minted by the repeated import, what observable result confirms completion, and what happens when no unique match can be made?
options: The consumer rereads each stable project id and replaces its stored `customer_ref` from the new context
The repeated import returns and preserves an old-to-new `customer_ref` mapping for consumers or the owner
The owner manually identifies each replacement and directs the consumer to relink it
set_aside.default_guess: Have each consumer refresh by the stable imported project id, replace the stored `customer_ref` with the current context value, and report any project that cannot be resolved uniquely.
